topBarSquare: Tap to open a node, long-press for commands
paletteEmpty: Nothing can act here right now
archiveSkipped_one: {{count}} selected item has no archive of its own and was left as it was
archiveSkipped_other: {{count}} selected items have no archive of their own and were left as they were
newTaskRefused: A Task cannot go here: select where it belongs first
paletteSelectHint: While on, a tap adds a node to the selection or takes it out
gestureTapDoes: Selects the node; tapping the selected node again deselects it
gestureStatusIconDoes: Selects the node and steps its status, as Enter does
gestureDoubleTapDoes: Goes into the node (the Mindmap enters a leaf too; elsewhere a node with nothing beneath it opens its editor); what that means is each view's, below
gestureLongPressDoes: Opens the node's quick action menu
gestureSwipeRightDoes: Advances the status: a Task's, a Commitment's verdict, a wait's release
gestureTwoFingerSwipeDoes: Left shows the next preset, right the previous
gestureMindmapMoveDoes: Moves it under another parent or reorders it
gestureMindmapDotDoes: Folds or unfolds the node's children
gestureListLeaf: Double-tap a row with nothing beneath it
gestureListParentDoes: Enters its subtree; the breadcrumb leads back up
gestureStepsEnterDoes: Steps into it, or opens its editor when it has nothing beneath it
gesturePlanMove: Swipe a to-plan item either way
gesturePlanMoveDoes: Slides it out the way you swiped and plans it into the scope
gesturePlanUnplan: Swipe a planned item either way
gesturePlanUnplanDoes: Slides it out the way you swiped and moves it back to the to-plan pane
gesturePlanEnterDoes: Enters its subtree, or opens its editor when it has nothing beneath it
gestureZenOpenDoes: Enters its subtree in the List View, or opens its editor when it has nothing beneath it
